provenanceNote: On main ce8b666, the squash of slice 7a (#223). After 811fc86, 7a gained a silent completed dive, the torch and the nav pad only while diving, the waves stopped after the end, and the 18 m BCD fixture compared to 12 places. The rebase onto ce8b666 (git rebase --onto origin/main 811fc86) kept this slice's own commits and applied without conflicts: updateHud keeps 7a's hiding of the nav pad and torch beside this slice's readouts, and the claims register keeps main's anchors beside this slice's. 17cecdf compares the 28 m neutral BCD fixture to 12 places, as Math.pow differs in the last bits on linux CI. 0c4e812 reads a completed dive's ascent rate as 0 and shows it no safety stop: a completed dive is never stepped again, so a dive surfaced fast past a paused stop kept the SLOW DOWN warning, '⚠ ↑ 25 m/min' and the paused stop row on its HUD for good, where legacy's post-dive state draws no dive computer. f1a7b30 addresses pre-review pass 1 on #226: the stop row keeps legacy's 'SAFETY STOP / Complete' once done, until the stop starts over below 11 m or the dive ends, and gives way to deco on the model's ceiling of the same tick (log.lastCeilingM at the dive's GF high, legacy's frameCalc.ceiling) instead of the worker's forecast, which is pending after every gas switch, setpoint change and bailout and on a resumed dive. 9119385 and 9fc2322 close two first-frame races in existing specs: the CNS test lost an I press on linux CI (run for 722438f), and the cross-client trace failed once on 9119385 under load (below); both now wait for the dive's first frame, with no assertion changed. The surface wait reads 0 m/min with no stop and no gauge, as legacy's drawSurface() draws the dive computer at rest. The full run above is on 9fc2322; later commits only update this file, so src, tests, scripts and docs are identical to the measured tree (see durableProvenance).

portedFromTheOracle.ascentRate: src/renderer.js drawDiveComputer: the chevrons' direction past 0.5 m/min and Math.round(|ascentRate|) in m/min; the rate is the model's log.ascentRateMpm, legacy's -(depth - prevDepth) / dtDiveMinutes.
portedFromTheOracle.fastAscent: The warning banner's SLOW DOWN past 9 m/min up (warnSlow), ranked below the oxygen warning and above the gas warnings as legacy's banner ranks it, with the hasWarning beep through the alert.warning cue; in words in the alert region and the status chip, and a ⚠ on the rate's row.
portedFromTheOracle.safetyStop: The stop box's safety-stop half: the nominal depth round((2.4 + 8.3) / 2) = 5 m with calculateSafetyStopDuration() before the countdown, then the floored countdown, paused (caution tone, and the word) outside the band; once done, `else if (safetyStopComplete)`: 'SAFETY STOP / Complete', until the diver goes back below 11 m (the model's reset) or the dive ends. Legacy draws the English literal in both languages; the German row reads 'Absolviert', legacy's German debrief word (gradeNotes.safetyDone). While there is a ceiling the box shows the decompression stop instead (showStopBox = inDeco || ...): decided on the model's log.lastCeilingM, legacy's frameCalc.ceiling of the same tick, not on the worker's forecast.
portedFromTheOracle.ruleOfThirds: hud-thirds: shown under an overhead, the phase by legacy's strict > 2/3 and > 1/3 over all cylinders' gas against the plan, and Math.round of the fraction; the turn in the caution tone, the reserve with the ⚠ of its danger tone; playAlertBeep() once as thirdsTurnWarned latches, not again on resuming a latched dive.
portedFromTheOracle.claims: docs/baseline/claims-register.json anchors the new strings in both locales: wreck.warning.fastAscent, wreck.hud.warning.fastAscent and wreck.hud.ascentRate* under ASCENT-001, wreck.hud.safetyStop* (Complete included) under SAFETY-STOP-001, wreck.hud.thirds* under GAS-001.
portedFromTheOracle.afterTheEnd: Legacy's post-dive state draws no dive computer, and updateCompletion logs a stop not made as skipped as the dive ends: the presentation reads a completed dive's rate as 0 and owes it no stop, so the rate row, the SLOW DOWN warning and the stop row do not stay frozen on the ended dive's HUD.

Each file was restored byte for byte (filecmp) and the tree checked clean after the set. Run on 9fc2322 with fresh backups: all thirteen fail as listed. The former check 'the safety stop shown when already complete' encoded legacy's missing Complete state and is replaced by the three Complete checks.
